name: acculynx
description: Full-featured AccuLynx connector: a bundled LLM-first CLI covering the complete AccuLynx v2 API (jobs, leads, contacts, financials, payments, documents, reports) plus skills for guided workflows and PDF document generation.

acculynx_api_key.title: AccuLynx API Key
acculynx_api_key.description: Your AccuLynx v2 API key (from my.acculynx.com/apikeys). Stored in secure storage, never in plain settings.

acculynx_signer_email.title: Signer Email
acculynx_signer_email.description: AccuLynx user email used to sign generated PDFs (COCs, roof reports). Optional — company defaults apply if omitted.
